entries.description: Stay where you are and rest briefly.
Walk around without a fixed goal and look at the surroundings.
Walk to the nearest place not seen yet and look at the land there.
Walk to a specific object.
Look closely at an object to learn about its properties.
Pick up a small object and carry it.
Put down a carried object.
Eat an object.
Drink from an object or water source.
Lie down and sleep to restore energy.
Walk towards another inhabitant.
Start a conversation with another inhabitant.
Use two or more objects together.
Climb up a thing that gives grip, or towards a thing up high from below it.
Put this thing into a fire.
Warn another inhabitant about something believed dangerous (passes on knowledge).
Show another inhabitant an object or how something works (passes on knowledge).
Teach another inhabitant what one knows about something (passes on knowledge).
Tell another inhabitant one's own name on a first meeting; the other usually answers with theirs.
Use a made thing for what it is for.
Put this thing on and wear it on the body.
Take off what you wear and lay it down.
Work one material into a building step of an invention.
Take this thing for the building in place of the missing material.
Stop building and leave the thing as far as it is built.
Ask this person to bring the missing material.
Stop building this thing for good.
Stay close to another inhabitant and seek its attention.
Ask another inhabitant to stay together for good.
Tell one's partner that one no longer stays together.
Tell one's partner that one wishes for a child.
Stay with another inhabitant and look after it.
Move about freely for the joy of it.
Work the surface of a thing with the hands for a long time.
Make a long sound with the voice that rises and falls.
Put colour onto the surface of a thing.
Move the body in a repeated rhythm.
Speak loudly against another inhabitant.
Tell another inhabitant that one is sorry.
Come together again with another inhabitant after a quarrel.
Tell another inhabitant about a third one.
Stay by another inhabitant who does not move any more.
Lay something over another inhabitant.
Lay another inhabitant who does not move any more into the ground.
Set something upright in the ground as a mark.
Go to a place where someone lies in the ground and stay there.
Give another inhabitant a name.
Do what one does the same way at the same time as before.
Stay at a new place for good with others.
Travel to a far shore.
